purpose: Addressed commands over the act journal. Unlike page commands they name their targets explicitly, so they neither depend on what the person has selected nor cancel each other: many agents can use them at once.

commands.result: the journal's effective kinds, categories and decisions, the record invariants and limits, the addressed and pointing commands, and the permission tiers

input.view: summary | act | target | board | review | decided | leases | presence | history | kinds

input.author: an agent or a mixed author; a human act comes only from the person's own interface

commands.result: sequence, id, digest and lease collisions

input.acts: up to 100 acts as for tos.act.append

commands.result: the appended acts and the first refusal, if any

allows: tos.act.append of note, reply, lease, release, kind-declaration and declared kinds

authority_limit: An act is local personal work. It never writes ToS source, candidate intake, review, rights or canon; a review act is the person's own decision. An agent cannot append a review, an assignment, a withdrawal of another author's act or an act in the person's name.
